title: Linear Inequalities and Absolute Value | Algebra I, Unit 3 (with Worked Examples)
description:
Solve and graph inequalities on a number line, learn why the sign flips when you multiply or divide by a negative, solve compound inequalities with AND and OR, then solve absolute value equations and inequalities. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
